question: Should Discord source-message subagent progress use the existing typed subagent hooks with a minimal config surface, or become a new typed ChannelPlugin capability with the full reaction and typing configuration proposed here?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing mode, seven config fields, public hook metadata, and a new channel/core boundary; code correctness review cannot select that permanent product and plugin contract.

options.title: Narrow to existing hooks
options.body: Use typed `subagent_spawned` and `subagent_ended` observation for Discord progress and retain only the minimum durable opt-in settings.

options.title: Approve a channel capability
options.body: Add an explicit typed ChannelPlugin source-progress capability, compatibility documentation, and sibling-channel rationale before merging.

options.title: Pause for broader liveness design
options.body: Hold this PR until the related cross-channel subagent liveness and yielded-parent lifecycle direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Narrow to existing hooks
recommendation.body: Use typed `subagent_spawned` and `subagent_ended` observation for Discord progress and retain only the minimum durable opt-in settings.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the central subagent lifecycle and public channel/plugin boundary, where this person has the strongest recent merged history.
